name: match-start-slam
intent: Giant START slams over the host, holds, then tears away along frozen diagonal clip halves to reveal MATCH LIVE.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Skip overlay; MATCH LIVE panel at full opacity immediately

acceptance: START overlay slams from scale 3.2 to 1 over 500ms with overshoot settle
Tear halves use frozen clip-paths at 58%/42% diagonal seam
Halves exit at frozen translate/rotate deltas over 380ms
MATCH LIVE content reaches full opacity after tear completes
Replay resets to idle pending state
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) skips slam and tear
waveC: Frozen tear clip-paths and exit deltas; stronger slam overshoot
